question: What claim is at stake in restricting giving to one who is endowed with all states and of resolved mind?
premises: A gift is said to be to be given.
The recipient is described as endowed with all states.
The recipient is also described as one of resolved mind.
inference: Only one endowed with all states and of resolved mind is fit to receive what is to be given.
uncertainties: What is to be given is not specified here.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states, to one of resolved mind.
